title.en: Eigenvalues, spectral geometry, and quadratic forms
title.zh: 特征值、谱几何与二次型

lead.en: Verify invariant directions, distinguish defective maps from symmetric spectral geometry, classify quadratic forms, and predict linear iterations with explicit assumptions.
lead.zh: 验证不变方向，区分亏损映射与对称谱几何，分类二次型，并按明确假设预测线性迭代。

prerequisites.en: Module 12: orthonormal bases, projection and QR. Recall determinant/inverse and basis-coordinate changes from Modules 10–11. Complex numbers are introduced locally.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 12：标准正交基、投影与 QR。回顾模块 10–11 的行列式、逆与换基；本课介绍所需复数。

en: Compute and verify eigenpairs in small real matrices.
Prove diagonalisation from a complete independent eigenbasis and recognise defective examples.
Explain the real symmetric spectral theorem and its finite-dimensional proof.
Classify symmetric quadratic forms and their level-set geometry.
Use matrix powers and spectral radius with stated stability assumptions.
Derive Rayleigh bounds and the positive-definite two-norm condition ratio.
Validate numerical eigenvectors despite sign, ordering and repeated-eigenspace ambiguity.
zh: 计算、验证小实矩阵特征对。
由完整独立特征基证明对角化，识别亏损例子。
解释实对称谱定理及有限维证明。
分类对称二次型及等值集几何。
按稳定性假设使用矩阵幂与谱半径。
推导瑞利界与正定二范数条件比。
处理符号、排序与重复特征空间歧义后验证数值特征向量。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and compare rotation and a defective map.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，比较旋转与亏损映射。
阅读特征对与对角化选段。

text.en: Verify eigenpairs and explain the required basis.
text.zh: 验证特征对并解释所需基。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and trace the symmetric spectral proof.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节，追踪对称谱证明。

text.en: Compare hand eigenpairs with numerical reconstruction.
text.zh: 比较手算特征对与数值重构。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6, including the scope of each spectral condition.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，注明各谱条件范围。

text.en: Compare contraction growth and transient amplification.
text.zh: 比较收缩、增长与暂态放大。

text.en: Diagnose sign ambiguity defects and misuse of symmetric solvers.
text.zh: 诊断符号歧义、亏损与误用对称求解器。

text.en: Complete choices and the written stability argument.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面稳定性论证。

text.en: Read official eig and eigh contracts.
text.zh: 阅读官方 eig 与 eigh 约定。

text.en: Use the quadratic explorer and complete the exit task.
text.zh: 使用二次型探索器并完成结业任务。
